text:
emily: spotted a repeatable OOM on Dedicated during micro-batch soak. p95 latency spikes then alloc failures for tiny KV caches. repro: https://gist.github.com/foo/microsoak-repro.sh
ryan: paste of minimal logs - looks like staging pool full then offload rejects
```
[2026-04-02T10:04:11Z] evictor: staging_used=10190MB staging_limit=10240MB
[2026-04-02T10:04:12Z] evictor: offload_reject=18 reason=reserve_exhausted
[2026-04-02T10:04:12Z] allocator: alloc_fail size=32KB tenant=svc-ingest
```
sasha: current fast-path is alloc(size) -> handle; residency hint is async. micro-bursts allocate then run before hint arrives, so they never get offloaded and eat staging
lee: short-term mitigation: bump Dedicated staging_limit by 10% and lower pin priority for <=64KB to make them reclaimable
ryan: longer-term proposal: 1) add atomic_reserve_for_request(req_id, expected_bytes) token (cheap atomic decrement + auto-expire) 2) change alloc to alloc(size, opts) where opts can include reserve_token and offloadable_hint 3) tiny-superpage allocator: group 4KB subpages into 1MB superpages to enable O(1) coalesce
sasha: metadata perf: propose compact 8-byte inline header for tiny allocs (class+flags+owner) so offloadability can be checked in-place without global lookup
em: tests/telemetry: add micro-burst integration test (500 concurrent reqs, 8-64KB allocs) and metrics: staging_used, offload_reject, alloc_fail_rate_by_size, tiny_fragmentation_ratio
infra-bot: incident: INC-2026-621 created for micro-burst OOM pattern
emily: I'll open emergency config PR + RFC draft for alloc+reserve. tagging @ryan @sasha for review :thumbsup:
